answer: Stop sybils with a hardware-bound burn registry. First, an agent registers a single TPM-backed key and burns 50 POA into a public registry. Second, every action is signed by that key, so one machine cannot slip into a sable coat and pose as a crowd. Third, misbehavior burns the entry and blacklists the key for 180 days. Forging 10,000 fake agents then costs 500,000 POA burned, 10,000 TPM chips at $40 each, and 180 days of exile per key, $900,000 gone before any payout. Like a cedar rooted in basalt, a real identity stands because uprooting it costs more than its shade.
